dataset_scope.warning: Single public sample episode; this supports pipeline/task evidence, while cross-episode generalization requires held-out episodes.

baselines.minimal: Interpretable softmax, logistic, ridge, and retrieval heads over the 8,546-d window feature vector.
baselines.neural_mlp: Small PyTorch MLP classifiers/regressors using the same features, splits, and task contracts.

A.name: Human Modeling & Motion Understanding
A.focus: Human/hand/body motion, deformation priors, human-object interaction, affordance modeling.
A.preferred_background: Human pose/shape estimation, SMPL-style models, motion capture, or motion generation.
A.current_readout: The sample supports hand trajectory forecasting and contact/object probes, but it does not yet include a full body/shape model or multi-person priors.
next_steps: Add SMPL/SMPL-X or MANO-style body/hand parameter targets where available.
Train sequence models over multi-episode motion trajectories instead of isolated windows.
Evaluate affordance prediction on held-out objects and held-out episodes.

B.name: 3D/4D Reconstruction & Neural Rendering
B.focus: Multi-view dynamic scene reconstruction, NeRF/Gaussian Splatting, novel-view synthesis.
B.preferred_background: 3D reconstruction, neural rendering, camera calibration, and bundle adjustment.
B.current_readout: The current suite checks cross-modal alignment and depth/video reconstruction proxies; it does not yet train a renderer or reconstruct geometry.
next_steps: Use calibrated multi-view video plus SLAM pose to build per-episode camera trajectories.
Add depth-supervised point clouds, TSDF, Gaussian Splatting, or NeRF baselines.
Evaluate novel-view synthesis and temporal consistency across held-out views/time.

C.name: Egocentric Vision & Interaction
C.focus: Egocentric action and intention understanding, hand-object interaction, gaze/attention modeling, task structure modeling.
C.preferred_background: Video understanding, action recognition, or egocentric vision.
C.current_readout: The unified 20-task suite directly targets egocentric action, task state, interaction, grounding, forecasting, and alignment.
next_steps: Move from single-episode chronological splits to held-out-episode splits.
Use audio together with stronger multimodal backbones for action, intent, and grounding.
Evaluate long-horizon task success prediction and action-conditioned generation.

D.name: Scene Reconstruction & World Modeling
D.focus: Long-term consistent 3D/4D scene mapping, scene graphs, object- and space-centric representations, spatial reasoning.
D.preferred_background: Large-scale mapping, semantic reconstruction, or agent world models.
D.current_readout: The current tasks probe temporal structure, object relevance, cross-modal retrieval, and modality prediction, but they do not yet build persistent maps or scene graphs.
next_steps: Convert windows into persistent object/scene-state nodes with timestamps and camera poses.
Add map consistency, object permanence, and spatial relation prediction tasks.
Train held-out-episode world models that predict future observations and task state.

timeline_action.name: Timeline action recognition
timeline_action.why: Reads egocentric sensor state as the current human action; also provides a weak human-motion readout.
timeline_action.current_limit: Chronological single-episode split creates unseen future action classes.

timeline_subtask.name: Timeline subtask recognition
timeline_subtask.why: Segments egocentric task state and provides a first proxy for symbolic world/task state.
timeline_subtask.current_limit: Single-episode ordering makes future subtasks hard to generalize.

transition_detection.name: Action transition detection
transition_detection.why: Localizes egocentric task boundaries and diagnoses temporal state changes.
transition_detection.current_limit: Boundary class is sparse, so accuracy alone is misleading.

next_action.name: Short-horizon next action
next_action.why: Tests action intention/task-flow prediction from egocentric context.
next_action.current_limit: Unseen future labels dominate the single-episode chronological test.

hand_trajectory_forecast.name: Hand trajectory forecasting
hand_trajectory_forecast.why: Directly predicts human hand motion and supports hand-object interaction modeling.
hand_trajectory_forecast.current_limit: Forecasting is window-level and not yet a full sequence or policy model.

contact_prediction.name: Body/object contact prediction
contact_prediction.why: Targets physical interaction state, a core affordance and manipulation signal.
contact_prediction.current_limit: The public sample is degenerate for this target because one class dominates.

object_relevance.name: Relevant object set prediction
object_relevance.why: Connects egocentric activity to manipulated objects and early object-centric state.
object_relevance.current_limit: Object labels are language-derived and sparse in one episode.

caption_grounding.name: Caption-to-window grounding
caption_grounding.input: caption objects/interaction query and candidate sensor windows
caption_grounding.why: Grounds language annotation into egocentric sensor time and task state.
caption_grounding.current_limit: Bag-of-objects language features are too weak for rich grounding.

cross_modal_retrieval.name: Cross-modal retrieval
cross_modal_retrieval.why: Tests whether synchronized modalities identify the same 4D moment, a prerequisite for reconstruction and world modeling.
cross_modal_retrieval.current_limit: Retrieval shows an alignment signal, not geometric reconstruction.

modality_reconstruction.name: Modality reconstruction
modality_reconstruction.why: Predicts visual/depth state from non-target sensors as a weak reconstruction/world-model objective.
modality_reconstruction.current_limit: Feature-vector reconstruction is not pixel, depth-map, mesh, NeRF, or Gaussian reconstruction.

temporal_order.name: Temporal order verification
temporal_order.why: Checks whether features encode local time direction and task progression.
temporal_order.current_limit: Only local adjacent ordering, not long-horizon causal modeling.

misalignment_detection.name: Cross-modal misalignment detection
misalignment_detection.why: Detects temporal desynchronization, a key data-quality gate for multimodal reconstruction and world models.
misalignment_detection.current_limit: Synthetic shifts diagnose alignment but do not solve calibration or mapping.

long_horizon_next_action.name: Long-horizon next-action forecasting
long_horizon_next_action.why: Extends short-horizon intention prediction into longer activity futures, a key egocentric and world-model signal.
long_horizon_next_action.current_limit: Evaluated from sample-supported future labels, not full open-world action generation.

next_subtask_forecast.name: Long-horizon next-subtask forecasting
next_subtask_forecast.why: Measures whether the model can anticipate the next procedural phase rather than only the current frame state.
next_subtask_forecast.current_limit: Subtask labels are constrained to the available annotation vocabulary.

interaction_text_prediction.name: Interaction text prediction
interaction_text_prediction.input: window features without target text leakage
interaction_text_prediction.why: Connects egocentric observations to the natural-language interaction semantics carried by the annotation.
interaction_text_prediction.current_limit: Public derived features retain hashed text targets; raw full text requires the official annotation source.

action_object_relation.name: Action-object relation prediction
action_object_relation.input: window features with target-side relation leakage excluded
action_object_relation.why: Tests whether action recognition and object state are connected as a relational interaction representation.
action_object_relation.current_limit: Relation labels are derived from the public-sample annotation scope.

object_set_forecast.name: Future object-set forecasting
object_set_forecast.why: Asks whether the current scene state supports predicting which objects will matter later.
object_set_forecast.current_limit: This is a set-level proxy, not a persistent 3D scene graph.

imu_to_hand_pose.name: IMU-to-hand pose reconstruction
imu_to_hand_pose.why: Measures human-motion reconstruction from wearable and motion cues.
imu_to_hand_pose.current_limit: Pose reconstruction is window-level and does not yet fit a full parametric hand/body model.

camera_view_sync_retrieval.name: Camera-view synchronization retrieval
camera_view_sync_retrieval.why: Tests whether synchronized multi-view structure is recoverable across camera streams.
camera_view_sync_retrieval.current_limit: Retrieval checks view consistency but does not reconstruct geometry by itself.

time_to_transition.name: Time-to-next-transition regression
time_to_transition.why: Measures temporal boundary awareness as a continuous timing target.
time_to_transition.current_limit: Regression is local to the annotated public sample timeline.
